service.description: Replies to Balun's HDHomeRun discovery. The request goes to the IPv4 broadcast address (or the IPv6 link-local multicast group) on 65001/udp, and each tuner answers from its own address and port 65001. Connection tracking does not match that reply to the broadcast request, so it arrives as new traffic: this accepts UDP from source port 65001. Unicast discovery of a known tuner needs no rule.
